result.summary: Implemented the CODE-DESIGN-VALIDATOR-approved design at lib/letflow/design/req209-expr-differential-corpus-regression.md. test/fixtures/simulation/differential_corpus.json ports all 15 entries (gw-001..gw-015) verbatim from c:/Users/tvolo/dev/ai-dala/R-Co/tests/differential/corpus/conditions_v1.json -- structural equality confirmed programmatically (Jason.decode!/1 on both files, a == b => true, 15 == 15). test/letflow/engine/expr_differential_corpus_test.exs implements a single property-style test with one Enum.reduce/3 loop over all 15 fixture entries, calling Expr.evaluate_condition/2 (the same composed path Transition.dispatch_exclusive_gateway/4 uses) and asserting actual == expected_result per entry, labelled by condition_id on failure. Test's own run output asserts evaluated_count == 15, expected_unsupported_count == 0, and their sum == 15 -- all 15 entries accounted for.
